entities.summary: Roman, a notable figure in the history of Slovenia, associated with Prehistoric & Roman Emona (200 BCE–476). Preceded by Roman Emona & Poetovio and Ljubljana Marshes wooden wheel crafted – oldest in the world. Their legacy influenced Carantania – one of the earliest Slavic polities – established.
